tasks.description: Add OrderedMultiDict.setlist(key, values) to dictutils per the contract.
tasks.spec_ref: CONTRACT setlist(key, values) on OrderedMultiDict: `values` is any iterable. If it is empty, every (key, *) pair is removed (no error if key is absent). Otherwise every existing (key, *) pair is removed and the new values are inserted, in order, at the position of the key's first existing occurrence in items(multi=True); if key was absent they are appended at the end. omd[key] then returns the last new value. Returns None. Also available on FastIterOrderedMultiDict. Docstring with doctest, and tests.

tasks.description: Add URL.replace_query(key, values) to urlutils returning a NEW URL with key's query values replaced, built on OrderedMultiDict.setlist.
tasks.spec_ref: replace_query(key, values) -> URL. `values` is a str (one value), an iterable of str, or None. Returns a new URL; self is not mutated. Uses the new URL's query_params.setlist(key, values) (see the setlist CONTRACT: position of first occurrence is kept; None or empty removes the key). to_text() of the result reflects the change. CONTRACT setlist(key, values) on OrderedMultiDict: `values` is any iterable. If it is empty, every (key, *) pair is removed (no error if key is absent). Otherwise every existing (key, *) pair is removed and the new values are inserted, in order, at the position of the key's first existing occurrence in items(multi=True); if key was absent they are appended at the end. omd[key] then returns the last new value. Returns None.

tasks.description: Add URL.without_query_params(*keys) to urlutils returning a NEW URL with every value of the given query keys removed.
tasks.spec_ref: without_query_params(*keys) -> URL. Removes all values of each key; keys that are absent are ignored; other params keep their order; self is not mutated; with no keys it returns an equal copy. Tests including repeated keys.
